data.paper_literal_comparison: Paper-literal line: 65,151 rows, 80% Alpaca target, no reserved KNN holdout. The public Alpaca supply makes the actual mix about 79.82/20.18; the KNN sample is drawn from the full Alpaca pool and may overlap training, matching Appendix C.1 more literally than the question-disjoint v2 line.

notes: Paper-literal line, separate from the stricter question-disjoint v2 line. Recipe is PMLR 306 Appendix D.6 / Table 9.
Table 9: 65,151 rows, 8 epochs, BS/GPU 64 x 4 GPUs = 256 effective => ceil(65151*8/256)=2036 steps. Built by prepare_osnip_datasets.py --paper-literal (65,151 rows, 80% target, no KNN reserve).

KNN set is prepare_paper_attack_sets.py WITHOUT --knn-reserved, sampled from the full Alpaca pool (may overlap training, as C.1 implies). Do not overwrite the v2 attack-set directory; use a separate output directory.
All other fields follow the formal 3B recipe: lr 1e-5, tau [0.05,0.15], loss warm-up 10, lambda1/lambda2 1/2, seed 42, raw_r, epsilon 0.3 (<0.4), delta 1.0 (>0.5).
